WITH date_series AS (
    -- Generate a series of all dates between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo()
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::date,  -- Start of the time filter
        $__timeTo()::date,    -- End of the time filter
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_readings AS (
    -- Fetch daily power meter readings from the database
    SELECT
        DATE(datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS date,  -- Convert to Asia/Kolkata timezone
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_power
        END AS daily_power
    FROM
        user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 143  -- Filter by form_id
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
        AND datetime >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
        AND datetime < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
),
daily_consumption AS (
    -- Calculate daily consumption by subtracting the current reading from the next day's reading
    SELECT
        ds.date,
        CASE
            -- If either current reading or next reading is 0, set daily consumption to 0
            WHEN dr1.daily_power IS NOT NULL AND dr1.daily_power > 0 THEN dr1.daily_power
            ELSE NULL
        END AS daily_consumption
    FROM
        date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN 
        daily_readings dr1 ON ds.date = dr1.date  -- Join with the actual daily readings
)
SELECT
    date,  -- The date from the generated series
    SUM(daily_consumption) AS "Pump House"
FROM
    daily_consumption
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(date)
    AND date >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
    AND date < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
GROUP BY
    date
ORDER BY
    date;
